name: Reorder
tagline: Watches stock against your reorder points and drafts supplier orders
description: A purchasing desk for a small operation. It watches finished goods and materials against the thresholds you set, projects the date each line runs out, and drafts the supplier orders before a shelf goes empty. The drafts stay drafts , a human reviews and places every order.
author: RichGarrick
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
